Roflumilast is a bulk active pharmaceutical ingredient, not a retail-packed medicament, so it falls in Chapter 29 rather than 3004. It is an organic compound with a cyclopropylmethoxy, a difluoromethoxy, and a dichloropyridinyl benzamide structure. The benzamide group (a carboxamide) places it in heading 2924, which covers carboxyamide-function compounds. The pyridine ring is only a substituent on the amide nitrogen, so heading 2933 is not the better fit. Within 2924, subheading 2924.29 covers other cyclic amides, and the statistical suffix for "other" is 2924.29.7000 or similar. I am recalling the suffix from memory rather than checking the schedule, so it is the least certain part of the code. The 2924.29 "other" lines include 2924.29.47 (pharmaceutical-use items), 2924.29.62 (the 6-digit group for other pharmaceutical items), and 2924.29.71 and 2924.29.77 (other). I will go with 2924.29.7000.
